A NYC firefighter unloads on pro-Palestinian agitators protesting near the 9/11 Memorial on the 25th anniversary of the terror attacks.

The firefighter confronts the group as the nation gathers to remember the nearly 3,000 people killed on September 11, 2001. https://t.co/L7sx13

The New York Times is facing backlash over how it marks the 25th anniversary of 9/11, with critics blasting two stories focused on Islamophobia and the treatment of Muslim Americans in the years following the terror attacks.

One report says the attacks "unleashed a wave of hate"
